public_rationale: The disclosed 9% agreement is relevant background, but it predates the forecast and does not establish a subsequent borrowing. No decisive post-publication transaction was verified. With no deadline, the absence of such a transaction cannot count as failure.
limitations: Private borrowing terms may be unavailable.
One transaction would test the stated range, not statistically validate the phrase all but certain.
The claim's unspecified reporting basis must be resolved before a decisive financial comparison.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic will almost certainly have to borrow at 8% to 11% interest.

statement.excerpt: While we still don’t know what level of junk rating the agencies might award it, Anthropic is all but certain to have to raise debt in the 8% to 11% range — the kind of interest rate that can veer between harsh and unmanageable when you face rough headwinds, especially when you’re raising debt in the tens of billions.

our_interpretation: The plain reading concerns the annual interest rate on Anthropic's next substantial borrowing to fund its obligations.
Next substantial borrowing is an evaluator interpretation; the speaker names neither an issuance nor a minimum size.
The range includes 8% and 11%. Interest paid in kind counts as interest, but equity conversion discounts and fees must be disclosed separately.
A borrowing by a separate infrastructure financing vehicle is not automatically borrowing by Anthropic.
criteria.support_condition: Anthropic completes a substantial borrowing after publication at an annual interest rate between 8% and 11%, with evidence that it was required to fund its obligations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Anthropic completes the relevant substantial borrowing outside the stated range under comparable terms. A small subsidized facility or a separate project's borrowing does not suffice.
